name: E2E10-4 [210] 기능권한 미등록 → 전부 차단
_comment_ignore: /login.ub 404 = loginSuccess.jsp 컨텍스트 누락(알려진 현상). 세션은 정상

steps.script: (async()=>{const r=await fetch(uxl.getFunctionUrl('VOC1019','INQUIRY'),{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded','X-Requested-With':'XMLHttpRequest'},body:""});const t=await r.text();const st=(t.match(/"resultStatus":"(\w+)"/)||[])[1]||'';const denied=t.includes('권한이 없습니다');if(!denied)throw new Error('VOC1019 INQUIRY 기대 권한차단, 실제 '+st+' (서버 미강제)');})()

(async()=>{const r=await fetch(uxl.getFunctionUrl('VOC1019','EXPORT'),{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded','X-Requested-With':'XMLHttpRequest'},body:""});const t=await r.text();const st=(t.match(/"resultStatus":"(\w+)"/)||[])[1]||'';const denied=t.includes('권한이 없습니다');if(!denied)throw new Error('VOC1019 EXPORT 기대 권한차단, 실제 '+st+' (서버 미강제)');})()
